title: Quick Pancakes

steps.text: Mix the flour, eggs, milk, baking powder and salt in a bowl until you have a smooth batter.
Heat a pan over medium heat and melt the butter in it.
Pour a ladle of batter into the hot pan.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip the pancake and cook the other side until golden.
Serve the pancakes warm with maple syrup.

assumptions: I have taken 2 cups of flour as 240 g, since flour is a solid and goes by weight.
I have taken a splash of milk as 15 ml.
I have assumed 5 g of baking powder (one teaspoon).
I have taken a pinch of salt as 1 pinch.
I have assumed 15 g of butter for the pan.
I have assumed 60 ml of maple syrup to serve.
I have estimated 4 servings, 5 minutes of preparation and 15 minutes of cooking.
